description: File-type detection and merge dispatch contract. Detection order is first-match-wins per the slice-1043 table; dispatch proves routing to the real default adapters with disjoint-content unions. See structuredmerge/spec slices/slice-1043-merge-dispatch-contract.md.

detection_cases.name: appraisal_root_is_gemfile_by_order
detection_cases.note: Documented shadowing: the .gemfile rule fires before the appraisals rule.

dispatch_cases.name: markdown_conflict_proves_routing
dispatch_cases.note: markdown-merge's default preference resolves same-position conflicts to the destination — the destination winning proves the real merger ran (a passthrough would return the template). Template-only sections are NOT added by default; union behavior is merger policy, pinned by the merger's own conformance fixtures, not here.

dispatch_cases.name: yaml_preference_passthrough
dispatch_cases.note: Options reach the merger: with preference template the conflicting key takes the template value. Fixture option values are JSON scalars; hosts map enum options (preference, comment_merge_policy) to their native enum type (Ruby: symbols).

dispatch_cases.name: unregistered_type_returns_nil
dispatch_cases.note: Types with consumer policy have no default adapter; the caller falls back to template content.
